map.前后轴平均磨损差 ≥ 1.5 mm 建议换位；同轴左右差 ≥ 1.0 mm 多为: A front-to-rear axle average wear difference of ≥ 1.5 mm calls for rotation; a left-right difference on the same axle of ≥ 1.0 mm usually means abnormal pressure or poor alignment; a spread of ≥ 3 mm across all four tires means wear is irreversible and replacement in pairs is usually advised.
map.常规建议每 8000~10000 km 或每两次保养换位一次；驱动轮磨损速率通常: Rotate routinely every 8000~10000 km or every second service; driven wheels wear 20%~40% faster than trailing wheels, so rotating regularly evens out the life of the set.
map.💡 换位后需按车辆要求重新设定胎压监测（TPMS）位置并复紧螺栓，避免系统报错或: 💡 After rotation, re-set tire pressure monitoring (TPMS) positions as the vehicle requires and retorque the bolts, avoiding system errors and safety hazards.

map.前驱、后驱或四驱车按厂家规定制定换位方案，均衡四轮磨损、延长整组轮胎寿命。: Follow the manufacturer's rotation scheme on FWD, RWD and AWD cars to even out wear and extend the life of the set.
map.发现单侧或单轴磨损异常偏快时，结合胎压一致性与四轮定位排查轮毂、悬架隐患。: When one side or axle wears unusually fast, check pressure consistency and alignment to rule out wheel and suspension faults.
map.四轮磨损差异分析与换位建议: Four-wheel wear analysis and rotation advice
map.左前 5.2mm、右前 5.0mm、左后 6.8mm、右后 6.6mm，新胎 8: LF 5.2mm, RF 5.0mm, LR 6.8mm, RR 6.6mm, 8mm when new with 20000 km covered: front axle average wear (2.8+3.0)/2 = 2.9mm, rear axle (1.2+1.4)/2 = 1.3mm, a 1.6mm gap that reaches the rotation threshold (≥1.5mm). A front-wheel-drive car uses the cross pattern: LF to RR, RF to LR with the rears moving straight forward. The maximum four-wheel spread of 1.8mm is still acceptable; the right front has about 22700 km left and will reach the limit first, so track it closely.
map.多久换位一次比较合适？: How often should tires be rotated?
map.常规建议每 8000~10000 km 或每两次保养换位一次。驱动轮磨损速率通常: Rotate routinely every 8000~10000 km or every second service. Driven wheels wear 20%~40% faster than trailing wheels, so rotating regularly evens out life and can add about 20% to the mileage of the set.
map.单向花纹轮胎能交叉换位吗？: Can directional tires be rotated crosswise?
map.不能。单向花纹交叉换位会反转滚动方向，破坏排水沟槽设计，导致湿地抓地下降、胎噪增: No. Crossing a directional tire reverses its rolling direction, defeating the drainage groove design, reducing wet grip and raising noise, so only front-to-rear swaps are allowed and never side to side.
map.花纹深度须在胎面主沟槽多点测量取最小值，测量前清除沟槽内石子: Measure tread depth at several points in the main grooves and take the smallest reading, clearing stones from the grooves first
